import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Survival Rate by Class
plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
survival_by_class = data.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_by_class.index, y=survival_by_class.values, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.ylim(0, 1)

# 2. Survival Rate by Sex
plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
survival_by_sex = data.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
sns.barplot(x=survival_by_sex.index, y=survival_by_sex.values, palette='Set2')
plt.title('Survival Rate by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Gender')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.ylim(0, 1)

# 3. Age Distribution by Survival
plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
data_clean = data.dropna(subset=['age'])
sns.histplot(data=data_clean, x='age', hue='survived', multiple='stack', bins=20, palette='coolwarm')
plt.title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Age')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class
plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='pclass', y='fare', palette='muted')
plt.title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Fare')
plt.yscale('log')

# 5. Survival Count by Embarkation Port
plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
embark_survival = data.groupby(['embarked', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, color=['#d62728', '#2ca02c'], ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('Survival by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Embarkation Port')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])
plt.xticks(rotation=0)

# 6. Survival Rate by Class and Gender
plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
survival_pivot = data.groupby(['pclass', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_pivot.plot(kind='bar', color=['#ff9999', '#66b3ff'], ax=plt.gca())
plt.title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.legend(title='Gender', labels=['Female', 'Male'])
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.ylim(0, 1)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
